_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Quality Status Report
summary: The Quality Status Report provides periodic status of quality performance and quality documentation development to assess quality program progress and identify potential problem areas at the Combined Tactical Training Ranges.
use_relationship:
The Quality Status Report provides periodic status of quality performance and quality documentation development, to assist the government in assessing quality program progress, and to identify potential problem areas at the Combined Tactical Training Ranges (CTTR).
This data item description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Quality Status Report shall be in a format similar to that in Figure 1-3.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Quality Status Report shall include all of the information specified in Figures (1-3). It shall contain the following sections:

children.title: Section 1.0. Quality Assurance (QA) Audits.
children.content: This section shall contain information for QA audits scheduled, completed, and not completed and shall also include:

children.title: The equipment/site audited.
Location.
Audit type.
Scheduled date.
Completion date.
Work order number and date opened.
If applicable, remarks that contain reason for the delay, reschedule date, and reason for not performing the audit.
Section 2.0. Completed NCRs, CARs and PARs.
children.content: This section shall contain information for completed Non Conformities, Corrective Action Requests (CARs) and Preventive Action Requests (PARs) and include the following:

children.title: The number that were completed on or before scheduled due date, and number completed after scheduled due date.
children.content: Scheduled due date is the date that was first set when the NCR/CAR/PAR was generated (Note, this date shall not change and shall be left as a baseline.)

children.title: The site, description, work order number, source, date opened, scheduled due date, and actual completion date.
The age, number of days late.
Status.
In relation to the functional areas of the contract, the quantitative and qualitative benefits achieved as a result of successfully completing the NCR, CARs and PARs.
Section 3.0. Outstanding CARs/PARs.
children.content: This section shall specify the status of all outstanding CARs and PARs and shall identify the following:

children.title: Number of outstanding CARs and PARs that are on schedule, number anticipated to be completed late, and number currently past scheduled completion date.
The Age of the CAR/PAR.
Location, work order, description, source, date opened, status, and scheduled due date.
A justification for all past due scheduled completion date.
Dated update and description of activity performed towards completing CAR and PAR.
Section 4.0. Outstanding Nonconformities (NCRs).
children.content: This section shall contain the status of all outstanding NCRs and shall include the following:

children.title: Number of outstanding NCRs that are on schedule, number anticipated to be completed late, and number currently past scheduled completion date.
The NCR number and status.
Location, work order, description, date NCR was opened, source of the NCR, status, and scheduled due date.
The age of the NCR.
Dated update and description of activity performed towards completing NCR.
A justification for completing late and for delay.

preparation_instructions.title: Media Requirements.
preparation_instructions.content: The Quality Status Report shall be an electronic document compatible with Microsoft Office products version 2007.
